framing.controller: Existing105-byte F145 owned framing; native family1 at26, entry reference6, repeated target owner30/94 and source proxy41. Stored byte5=1 retained; not decoded as API isReference/isLinked.

framing.source: Owned proxy -> descriptor309 -> typed bounded-face recipe and four linked contexts, decoded by selection-context variants helper. Each output naming edge recipe matches exactly one source context edge recipe by full stored bytes.
framing.cycle: Output line start/end sketch point IDs repeat in one ordered four-edge cycle. This is a cached sketch graph property; source BRep boundary topology/ordering is unresolved.

generation_evidence.construction: GenerateConstructionModes.py creates the AxisPoint sketch with root.sketches.add(face) in axis_perpendicular_at_point; no explicit project call adds these four lines.
generation_evidence.holes: GenerateHolePlacements.py creates HoleLocations with root.sketches.add(top) before adding one/three hole placement points; no explicit project call adds these four lines.
generation_evidence.SDK: Installed adsk.fusion.Sketches.addWithoutEdges documentation says that with a BRepFace its edges are not projected and the new sketch is empty. Together with the actual stored controller/source graph and saved generator calls this supports the face-boundary classification.
generation_evidence.API_line_getter_status: Not captured in these original fixtures. Coordinates, tags and closed cycle below are independently framed native caches, not newly claimed API line getter comparisons.
